description: Check the draft. It returns a review to show the person. It sends nothing. Before submit, show the review from check_draft. It lists the answers in the person's words. It marks each missing required answer as 'Missing - required'. Ask the person to confirm it or correct it. Change answers until the person is done.

anything_else.description: Both tracks. Q7: Is there anything else you want us to know? Typed answer. Optional.

anything_else_more.description: Optional. The person's typed answer to your follow-up after Q: Is there anything else you want us to know?

become.description: Operator. Q6: What do you want it to become? One of: Stay as it is, but easier / Grow / Pass it on to someone / Not sure yet. Or the person's own typed words. Optional.

become_more.description: Optional. The person's typed answer to your follow-up after Q: What do you want it to become?

build_next.description: Talent. Q6: What do you want to build in the next few years? One of: My own company / Deep skill in my craft / A part in running a local business / Not sure yet. Or the person's own typed words. Optional.

build_next_more.description: Optional. The person's typed answer to your follow-up after Q: What do you want to build in the next few years?

business_kind.description: Operator. Q2: What kind of business is it? One of: Retail or food / Trades or construction / Farm or agriculture / Professional service / Manufacturing. Or the person's own typed words. Optional.

business_kind_more.description: Optional. The person's typed answer to your follow-up after Q: What kind of business is it?

business_name.description: Q1, Operator only. Business name. Optional.

draws_you.description: Talent. Q5: What draws you to the North Country? One of: The work here / The place and the people / I want to move here / I want to work here remotely. Or the person's own typed words. Optional.

draws_you_more.description: Optional. The person's typed answer to your follow-up after Q: What draws you to the North Country?

email.description: Q1. Email address where we can reply. Required.

info_lives.description: Operator. Q4: Where does most of your information live? One of: Paper / Spreadsheets / Software, for example QuickBooks / In people's heads / A mix. Or the person's own typed words. Optional.

info_lives_more.description: Optional. The person's typed answer to your follow-up after Q: Where does most of your information live?

job_start.description: Operator. Q3: How does a normal job start? One of: A customer calls or texts / They walk in / They order online / A repeat or contract customer / We go out and find them. Or the person's own typed words. Optional.

job_start_more.description: Optional. The person's typed answer to your follow-up after Q: How does a normal job start?

live_now.description: Talent. Q3: Where do you live now? One of: Lewis County / Elsewhere in the North Country / Elsewhere in New York / Outside New York. Or the person's own typed words. Optional.

live_now_more.description: Optional. The person's typed answer to your follow-up after Q: Where do you live now?

name.description: Q1. Name, as the person gave it. Required.

need.description: Optional. Both tracks. What the person needs or wants help with, in their own words, if they said it (for example in a follow-up or a typed answer). Do not ask an extra question for it.

track.description: What best describes you? client = "Operator: I make decisions inside of a business", talent = "Talent: I am talented and would like to talk". Required.

why_started.description: Operator. Q5: Why did you start or take on this business? One of: I built it / Family business / I bought it / I saw a need in town. Or the person's own typed words. Optional.

why_started_more.description: Optional. The person's typed answer to your follow-up after Q: Why did you start or take on this business?

work_kind.description: Talent. Q2: What kind of work do you do? One of: Software / Engineering or science / Trades / Design or media / Business or operations. Or the person's own typed words. Optional.

work_kind_more.description: Optional. The person's typed answer to your follow-up after Q: What kind of work do you do?

work_link.description: Q1, Talent only. Link to their work. Optional.

work_want.description: Talent. Q4: What kind of work do you want? One of: Full time / Part time / One project / Not sure yet. Or the person's own typed words. Optional.

work_want_more.description: Optional. The person's typed answer to your follow-up after Q: What kind of work do you want?

name: check_draft
title: Check a draft
